The compression pipeline evaluates each inbound payload to decide whether contextual information can be removed without harming the model's ability to answer correctly. Structured data such as JSON arrays and log files compresses extremely well because repeated fields carry little new information per row. Prose is harder: every sentence can carry a distinct fact, so aggressive removal risks dropping the one detail the user actually needed. The pipeline therefore routes content by type and applies the strongest compressor that still preserves answer-critical evidence.
